{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with sentinel values for biomarker_baseline
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the change in biomarker levels from baseline to follow-up
df_filtered['change'] = df_filtered['biomarker_final'] - df_filtered['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change for females and males, restricted to the treatment arm only
treatment_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Print the shape of the treatment arm subset
print(f'treatment_filtered.shape = {treatment_filtered.shape}')

# Compute the average change by sex
cat_change_treatment = treatment_filtered.groupby('sex')['change'].mean()

# Print the average change by sex
print(f'cat_change_treatment = {cat_change_treatment}')

# Compute the difference in average change between females and males
difference = cat_change_treatment['F'] - cat_change_treatment['M']

# Print the difference
print(f'difference = {difference}')"}
